verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents telephony transports and inbound carrier webhooks (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, SIP), and Pipecat Cloud advertises unlimited concurrency. Nothing in the evidence describes batch outbound call campaigns, campaign scheduling, or dialing throughput controls. Concurrency capacity and inbound call handling are adjacent features, not the campaign capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls
